mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, following_id) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followingId}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_follows DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND following_id = #{followingId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM follows WHERE following_id = #{userId}
mapper.sql: f.id AS follow_id, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.bio, u.icon_image_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows v WHERE v.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND v.following_id = u.id) AS following, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows v WHERE v.follower_id = u.id AND v.following_id = #{viewerId}) AS followed_by
